basis: Intellectual disability defines disease; amblyopia and bicuspid aortic valve each reported in 1/2 patients; frequencies uncertain in tiny samples. Clinodactyly lacks documented functional damage.
Ciliary dysfunction causes airway disease; bronchiectasis in 2/2 patients. Sperm abnormalities have no axis; recurrent infections do not establish primary immunodeficiency.
Foreskin constriction is a reproductive anatomical disorder outside the axes; underlying inflammatory conditions and diabetes are separate diseases.
Definition identifies neurologic dysfunction, intestinal defects and combined immunodeficiency as the principal disease spectrum; their combination varies across subtypes.
Neoplasm occupies the optic nerve, explicitly assigned to the ocular axis; CNS ancestry alone does not establish additional brain involvement.
Defined by corneal stromal opacities, establishing ocular location despite preserved vision; no additional organ damage.
Congenital limb deficiency with absence of forearm, wrist and hand directly defines musculoskeletal involvement.
Split-foot malformation is a dysostosis affecting skeletal development; no evidence supports additional organs.
Intracranial meningioma affecting the cerebral hemispheres is a tumour of the neurologic axis.
Carcinoma originates in paranasal sinus mucosa, assigned to pulmonary; bone-related ancestry does not establish common direct skeletal involvement.
